title.zh: 将苏禄省 Jolo市镇苏禄中学的名称变更为Dayang Hadji Piandao 纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Sulu High School in the Municipality of Jolo, Province of Sulu, to Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Sulu High School in the Municipality of Jolo, Province of Sulu, to Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Sulu tại Thị trấn Jolo, Tỉnh Sulu thành Trường trung học phổ thông Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sulu ในเทศบาล Jolo, จังหวัด Sulu เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Sulu di Kotamadya Jolo, Provinsi Sulu menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Sulu di Perbandaran Jolo, Wilayah Sulu menjadi Sekolah Menengah Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3712_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Sulu High School in the Municipality of Jolo, Province of Sulu, is hereby changed to Dayang Hadji Piandao Memorial High School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
